notes.title: Fate Trigger Closed Beta Has Ended
notes.notes: [p]Dear Awakeners,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible participation in the Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test! As of now, our CBT servers are officially offline. Your enthusiasm and valuable feedback have made this test a great success. Our game developers will thoroughly analyze all the collected data to improve the game for our reunion in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]We will keep sharing exclusive game news and development updates after the server shutdown. Stay tuned for our game updates![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Learn more about the game at: [url="https://bit.ly/fttn"]bit.ly/fttn[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Join our Discord Server at: [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Follow us on X at: [url="https://x.com/FateTrigger_EN"]x.com/FateTrigger_EN[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Follow us on Facebook at: [url="https://www.facebook.com/FateTrigger"]www.facebook.com/FateTrigger[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for being part of this journey![/p][p][/p][p]Fate Trigger Dev Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test Ending Soon
notes.notes: [p]Dear Awakeners,[/p][p][/p][p]The CBT is scheduled to shut down on [b]2025/08/26 06:00 (EDT)[/b], at which time the servers will be shut down and Awakeners will no longer be able to log in after this period. notes.title: Patch Update for July 31 - Fate Trigger CBT
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Dear Awakeners,[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to deploy a patch update for the [i]Fate Trigger[/i] Closed Beta Test on [b]Thursday, July 31st, at 4:00 PM EDT[/b].[/p][p]This update will be applied without server downtime. However, you will need to [b]restart your game client[/b] to download the patch before you can log back in.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Game Mode Arrival[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]>Team Deathmatch (FPP) - CBT Demo[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Time-Limited Mode, available for: [/b]Every Saturday and Sunday during the CBT from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight) [i]\[Depending on your server][/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mode Details:[/b] Squad up, pick your equipment, and rack up eliminations in this FPP! Victory goes to the first team to hit the score limit or the team with the most points when time's up![/p][/*][/list][p]*Note:[i] This is CBT demo which does not represent the final result. Feedback & suggestions are appreciated and will be carefully reviewed.
[/i][/p][h2][b]>Rapid Trials[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Time-Limited Mode, available for:[/b] Every Saturday and Sunday during the CBT from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight)[i] \[Depending on your server].[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mode Details:[/b] The Rapid Trial mode features a small-scale shrinking circle mechanism, offering a faster-paced combat experience. Awakeners can directly pick up and equip various weapon chips, while armor, compared to the Awakener Trial mode, comes with additional damage reduction. The TTK in this mode is also extended. Additionally, by accumulating damage to the enemies, your armor can evolve to higher levels! With rapid shrinking circles, intense fights, and strategic use of items, come challenge your in-game limits to crown the victory![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Update Details:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]>[/b] [b]Awakener Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Eos (Luminary):[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Diffraction (Ultimate): [/i]Duration increased from 20s to 25s. Now, downing an enemy extends the duration by 5s (up to a maximum of 25s).[/p][list][*][p][b]Xiva (Firestorm):[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Searing Munitions (Passive), Azure Divide (Tactical), & Corvite Storm (Ultimate):[/i] All abilities now apply an additional 25% slow effect that lasts for 2 seconds upon dealing damage.[/p][list][*][p][b]Soarwynne (Windranger):[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Skyward Leap (Tactical):[/i] Can now use weapons and items after the initial jump. The leap range has been adjusted from 13m ~ 35m to 7m ~ 35m.[/p][quote][p]Dev Note: "Soarwynne is currently underperforming compared to other Assault Awakeners. We want Skyward Leap to create more opportunities for high-impact plays. By increasing her options for jump height and allowing her to act during the leap, we hope to make her more dynamic."[/p][/quote][p][/p][h3][b]>[/b] [b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Gladiator Assault Rifle:[/b] Damage reduced (Upper Body: 35 → 33, Lower Body: 27 → 25). Increased long-range damage falloff.Slightly increased recoil.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]Dev Note: "Our goal for the Gladiator AR is for it to be a high-skill weapon that rewards practice. Currently, its ease of use is too similar to the entry-level CL-4 AR, and its high damage is crowding out other weapons. These adjustments are intended to better define its role."[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed several issues that could cause crashes, stuttering, or frame drops.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a UI display issue when DLSS Frame Generation was enabled.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed UI display issues that could occur after setting custom keybinds.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause interaction problems after setting custom keybinds.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug with deadzone settings for PlayStation controllers.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed various general controller interaction bugs.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue causing some missions to not track progress correctly.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue preventing recruitment/squad information from being deleted.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug with custom color settings for squad banners.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed several issues with the voice chat function.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug causing player stats to display incorrectly.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed display issues with some Charms.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue causing muzzle flash effects to display incorrectly.[/p][p][b]>[/b]  Fixed a bug where players could be repeatedly teleported while inside an updraft area.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue in some areas that could cause players to get stuck in a floating state.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug where the backpack UI would display incorrectly after reconnecting to a match.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue preventing ziplines from being used correctly.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Eos's Tactical ability to fail on activation.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed an issue that allowed Ryoin to use his long-range leap while on a zipline.[/p][p][b]>[/b] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from picking up equipment in the Training Grounds.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]Please remember that this CBT build does not represent the final version of the game. If you encounter any issues, please [/i][/p][p]join our official Discord server [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]https://discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url][/p][p][i] to submit bug reports and feedback. Our team will follow up and address them promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.[/i][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support![/p][p]
[/p][p]Fate Trigger Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Fate Trigger Closed Beta Playtest Known Issues FAQ
notes.notes: [p]Hello Awakeners, thank you for your incredible support for [i]Fate Trigger[/i]![/p][p]The server will be opened on [b]July 24th at 10:00 PM EDT[/b]. The end date for the playtest will be announced later.[/p][p]Please remember that this is a beta build, and its content and performance do not represent the final quality of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/eacf1c5e3ddaba110aefa30c4709acd7e1eb4bc5.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Playtest Access & Download Guide[/b][/h2][p][b]Q1: How can I get access to the Playtest?[/b][/p][p]A: Access can be obtained through several methods, including requesting access on our Steam page, Twitch Drops campaigns, and community giveaways on our official Discord.[/p][p][i](Note: Previous Closed Alpha participants on Steam have been granted access automatically.)[/i][/p][p][b]Q2: I have a Beta Key. How and where do I redeem it?[/b][/p][p][b]For Steam Keys[/b] (Obtained from Twitch Drops):[/p][olist][*][p]Open your Steam client.[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Games" in the top menu, then select "Activate a Product on Steam"[/p][/*][*][p]Follow the on-screen instructions and enter your Beta Key.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]For Website Launcher Keys[/b] (Obtained from Twitch Drops, Website events, Discord, or in-game Friend Referrals):[/p][olist][*][p]Go to our [b]official website[/b] and download the [i]Fate Trigger[/i] game client.[/p][/*][*][p]Install and run the launcher.[/p][/*][*][p]You will be prompted to create a [b]Saroasis Account[/b] (with your email) and enter your Beta Key to activate the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Proceed to download and install the full game through the launcher.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h2][b]PC System Requirements[/b][/h2][p][i](Note: These specifications are for the beta version and do not represent the requirements for the full release.)[/i][/p][p][b]Recommended Specs:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10/11 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor:[/b] Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 (Server CPUs not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory:[/b] 16 GB RAM (8GB*2)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600XT / Intel Arc B580 (Integrated graphics not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] Version 12[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage:[/b] 40 GB available space (SSD required)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Minimum Specs:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10/11 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor:[/b] Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700 (Server CPUs not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory:[/b] 8 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc B570 (Integrated graphics not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] Version 12[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage:[/b] 40 GB available space (SSD required)[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that the current Closed Beta build does not officially support [b]integrated graphics[/b] (e.g., Intel HD/Iris Xe Graphics) or [b]server-grade CPUs[/b]. We will continue to work on optimizing performance support for higher-end integrated graphics and server CPUs in the future.[/p][p]If your system does not meet the minimum requirements, you may be unable to run or participate in this test. We are continuously working on performance optimization and appreciate your understanding and support.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Technical Support & Performance FAQ[/b][/h2][p][b]Q1: What should I do if my game is crashing or gives an "Out of Video Memory" error? (For Intel 13th/14th Gen CPU users)[/b][/p][p]A: This is a known issue affecting some games for users with unlocked Intel 13th/14th Gen CPUs (e.g., i9-13900K, i7-14700K). As a first step, please try restarting the game. If the issue persists, please join our official Discord for further assistance from our support team.[/p][p][b]Q2: How can I fix stuttering issues when using an Intel Arc A580 GPU?[/b][/p][p]A: This may be caused by your virtual memory being configured on a Hard Disk Drive (HDD). We recommend configuring your virtual memory on a Solid-State Drive (SSD) to resolve this.[/p][p][b]Q3: How can I improve my in-game performance?[/b][/p][p]A: For the best experience, please consider the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]Storage:[/b] We strongly recommend installing [i]Fate Trigger[/i] on an SSD. If you are using an HDD, please set Textures to "Low" for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Frame Rate:[/b] The game defaults to a 60 FPS limit. You can increase this in Settings > Graphics > Display > FPS Limit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality vs. Performance:[/b] In Settings > Graphics > Quality > Graphics Quality, select "Low" for higher frame rates or "Ultra" for the best visual fidelity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Q4: Distant enemies look blurry or pixelated. How can I fix this?[/b][/p][p]A: This is often related to super-resolution settings. You can try the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]NVIDIA GPU:[/b] Go to Settings > Graphics > Quality > DLSS Quality and select "Quality".[/p][/*][*][p][b]AMD GPU:[/b] Go to Settings > Graphics > Quality > FSR Quality and select "Quality".[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alternatively:[/b] Go to Settings > Graphics > Anti-Aliasing and Super Resolution Method and try turning this option off. This will improve sharpness but may reduce performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Q5: What should I do if the game crashes with a GPU-related error like "GPU crashed or D3D device removed"?[/b][/p][p]A: This can often be resolved with one of two methods:[/p][list][*][p]Ensure your graphics drivers are updated to the latest version. [b]Please avoid NVIDIA Driver Version 576.52[/b], as it has a high probability of causing crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid using third-party overlay software such as MSI Afterburner, Game++, or FPS Monitor, as these can sometimes conflict with the game's GPU usage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Q6: What if I get a "Please upgrade your DirectX 12 and Graphics driver" error on launch?[/b][/p][p]A: Please try the following steps:[/p][list][*][p]Ensure your system's DirectX is updated to DirectX 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Visit the official NVIDIA or AMD website to download and install the latest graphics drivers.[/p][/*][*][p]Make sure your Windows version is updated to Windows 10 (version 19045) or higher.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Q7: What if my game won't run even if I meet the minimum requirements?[/b][/p][p]A: As this is a beta playtest, optimization for all hardware configurations is not yet complete. A small number of PCs that meet the minimum requirements may still have trouble launching the game. If you experience this, [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]join our official Discord server[/url] and submit a detailed bug report. We will investigate promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kW8TLRnaSEM;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p]We look forward to seeing you in the game! To discuss the test and get the latest news, be sure to join our official community.[/p][list][*][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]https://discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url][/p][/*][*][p]X: [url="https://x.com/FateTrigger_EN"]https://x.com/FateTrigger_EN[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/FateTrigger"]https://www.facebook.com/FateTrigger[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/fatetrigger_eng/"]https://www.instagram.com/fatetrigger_eng/[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: How to Fix Fate Trigger Client Crashes | Virtual Memory Setup Guide
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Awakeners,[/p][p]If you are experiencing client stuttering or crashes while playing Fate Trigger, particularly with the error message [b]"UE-S1Game Game has crashed and will now close,"[/b] you can often resolve this and improve game performance by adjusting your virtual memory.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/53bfae59c4e9ec8884946453b12935d8b29d77fc.png"][/img][/p][p]You can start by checking your current virtual memory settings. If the allocated amount is too low, try increasing it, restart your computer, and then launch the game to see if the issue is resolved.[/p][p][b]Important Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Drive Space:[/b] If your virtual memory is located on your C: drive, please ensure that the drive has ample free space.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drive Type:[/b] Setting your virtual memory on a Solid-State Drive (SSD) is highly recommended for better performance. Both of these factors can significantly impact your gaming experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Below is our guide for setting up virtual memory. We hope this helps! Please follow the steps as instructed.[/p][h3][b]How to Set Up Virtual Memory in Windows[/b][/h3][p] 1. [b]Click the Windows key[/b] and type [b]"View advanced system settings"[/b] into the search bar, then click to open it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/8fd282e5f98468f83d45dd212e52a19f72022f08.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]2. [b]In the window that opens, navigate as follows:[/b] Go to the [b]"Advanced"[/b] tab → Click [b]"Settings"[/b] under the [i]Performance[/i] section → Go to the [b]"Advanced"[/b] tab in the new window → Click [b]"Change"[/b] under the [i]Virtual memory[/i] section.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/0970db8e747a4fa217a9f2a55c58d9f301d6312d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/2dd554cd8ac89e2306463ff71da09d5029c0e4b1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/4a9e4fa7e51cb961045566f2dc692f9bcc1d90c0.png"][/img][/carousel][p] 3. [b]Configure your Paging File Size:[/b] Uncheck the box for [b]"Automatically manage paging file size for all drives."[/b] Then, select a drive (ideally an SSD with plenty of free space), select [b]"Custom size,"[/b] and set the Initial and Maximum size values.[/p][p][b]   a. Initial size (MB) Recommended Values:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]For 8 GB of RAM:[/b] Recommended value is at least [b]10240[/b] (10 GB).[/p][/*][*][p][b]For 16 GB of RAM:[/b] Recommended value is at least [b]20480[/b] (20 GB).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]  b. Maximum size (MB) Recommended Value:[/b][/p][list][*][p]It is recommended that all users set this value to at least [b]51200[/b] (50 GB).  [/p][/*][/list][p]  4. [b]After setting the values, click 'Set' and then 'OK'.[/b] If a System Properties notification appears, click [b]"OK"[/b] to confirm. You will need to [b]restart your computer[/b] for the changes to take effect.[/p][p][/p][p]If you continue to experience crashes after following this guide, please try lowering your in-game graphics settings or updating your graphics card drivers. If the problem persists, please report it to us via the BUG Feedback Form.  We will investigate your feedback and address the issue as soon as possible.[/p][p][url="https://bnjoal2t8r.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnfppghlcqMOA4H7oWOVwy6S" style="button"]BUG Feedback Form[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: How to Join the Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test
notes.notes: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/e29dfc8dd9f332bf777ca407769795162f172766.jpg"][/img][/h1][p]You can get access to the Closed Beta Test (CBT) through the following methods. There are two ways to get into the game: via [b]Steam[/b] or our [b]Official Website Launcher[/b]. Please double-check which platform each sign-up method is for.[/p][p][b]Request Access on Steam[/b][/p][list][*][p]Visit the official [url="https://fatetrigger.com/en-us/#/reservation"]Fate Trigger store page[/url] and click the "Request Access" button. This will enter you into a pool for a chance to be selected to play on Steam. (Note: Access is not guaranteed due to limited slots).[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092530/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Participate in Discord Events[/b][/p][list][*][p]Join our official [url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger"]Discord server[/url] and take part in special giveaways and community events. Winners will receive a [b]Beta Key[/b] for our [b]Official Website Launcher[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Earn Access via Twitch Drops[/b][/p][list][*][p]Link your game account and watch partnered [i]Fate Trigger[/i] streams during our official campaigns. By watching 60 minutes, you can earn a [b]Beta Key[/b] that can be redeemed on [b]Steam or [/b]the [b]Official website[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Receive an In-Game Friend Referral[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players already in the CBT can earn a shareable Beta Key by completing special in-game challenges. Your friend must then go to the official website to download the game launcher. After installing and running the launcher, they will be prompted to enter the Beta Key to activate their access.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]All Closed Alpha players will gain access to the Closed Beta Test[/b][/p][list][*][p]If you have participated in our last Closed Alpha test on Steam, you are all set! You will [b]automatically receive access[/b] to the CBT directly in your Steam library. No further action is needed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you in the game! To discuss the test and get the latest news, be sure to join our official community.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/1110d98a7010c2238d53657229e74b8bcc3bbfa9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: All you need to know about Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/41262afe686467371be404584dda71bc647a5707.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The wait is over! We are excited to announce that recruitment for the official Fate Trigger [b]Closed Beta Test (CBT)[/b] is now open. You can apply for a chance to play by requesting access on our [b]Steam page[/b], participating in [b]Twitch Drops[/b] campaigns, or through events on our [b]official website[/b] and [b]Discord server.[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/fatetrigger" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]For a full breakdown of the CBT schedule, PC requirements, and content, please read the detailed guide below.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]CBT Key Information[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]CBT Start Time:[/b] July 24, 2025, at 10:00 PM [b]EDT[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]CBT End Time:[/b] To be announced. Follow our official channels for the latest updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]How to Join:[/b] Apply via Steam, Twitch Drops, or community events. See the FAQ for full details.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Languages:[/b] English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, Thai, Russian, French, German, Italian, Polish, and Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Voice-Over Languages:[/b] English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Test Type:[/b] Limited Closed Beta Test. There will be no in-game purchases, and all account progress will be wiped after the CBT.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Server Locations:[/b] Japan, China, West Coast US, and East Coast US[/p][/*][*][p][b]Platform:[/b] PC[/p][/*][*][p][b]Login Via:[/b] Steam & Saroasis Account[/p][/*][*][p][b]Download From:[/b] Steam or the Official Website[/p][/*][*][p][b]Download Starts:[/b] July 24, 2025, at 10:00 PM [b]EDT[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]PC System Requirements[/b][/h3][p][i](Note: These specifications are for the beta version and do not represent the requirements for the full release.)[/i][/p][p][b]Recommended Specs:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10/11 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor:[/b] Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 (Server CPUs not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory:[/b] 16 GB RAM (8GB x 2)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600XT / Intel Arc B580 (Integrated graphics not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] Version 12[/p][/*][*][p][b]Network:[/b] Broadband Internet Connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage:[/b] 40 GB available space (SSD required)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Minimum Specs:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]OS:[/b] Windows 10/11 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor:[/b] Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700 (Server CPUs not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory:[/b] 8 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics:[/b] NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc B570 (Integrated graphics not supported)[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX:[/b] Version 12[/p][/*][*][p][b]Network:[/b] Broadband Internet Connection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage:[/b] 40 GB available space (SSD required)[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]Please note that the current Closed Beta build does not officially support [b]integrated graphics[/b] (e.g., Intel HD/Iris Xe Graphics) or [b]server-grade CPUs[/b]. We will continue to work on optimizing performance support for higher-end integrated graphics and server CPUs in the future.[/p][p]If your system does not meet the minimum requirements, you may be unable to run or participate in this test. We are continuously working on performance optimization and appreciate your understanding and support.[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3][b]Closed Beta: Content Overview[/b][/h3][p][b]Game Modes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Awakener Trials[/p][/*][*][p]Rapid Trials[/p][/*][*][p]Team Deathmatch[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game Maps:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Awakener Trials Map:[/b] Helix Airena[/p][/*][*][p][b]Team Deathmatch Maps:[/b] The Factory, The Armory[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Awakeners:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cynric[/p][/*][*][p]Ryoin[/p][/*][*][p]Mindy[/p][/*][*][p]Eos[/p][/*][*][p]Kira[/p][/*][*][p]Nase[/p][/*][*][p]Huxley[/p][/*][*][p]Soarwynne[/p][/*][*][p]Camille[/p][/*][*][p]Xiva[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicles:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Estelle AeroX (Four-Seater Sedan)[/p][/*][*][p]Buccellati Scatto (Two-Seater Sports Car)[/p][/*][*][p]Toya Otomo (Single-Person Vehicle)[/p][/*][*][p]Span Armadillo (Four-Seater SUV)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]FAQ: Registration and CBT Details[/h3][p][b]About CBT:[/b][/p][p][b]Q1: Is there any difference between playing on Steam versus the official website launcher?[/b][/p][p]No, none at all! The game content, features, and servers are [b]identical[/b]. All CBT players can play together in the same ecosystem, regardless of which launcher they use. The only difference is the platform you use to log in and update the game.[/p][p][b]Q2: How can I check if my PC is able to run the Closed Beta Test?[/b][/p][p]There are a couple of easy ways to check your PC's readiness:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Manual Check:[/b] Please review the [b]Minimum[/b] and [b]Recommended Specs[/b] in the "PC System Requirements" section above and compare them to your own computer's hardware. You must meet the minimum requirements to participate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Automated Check on Discord:[/b] For a quick verification, please join our official Discord server and head to the #spec-check channel. Inside, you will find a simple tool and instructions on how to automatically check if your system is ready for the CBT.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]What if I meet the specs but still have problems?[/b] If your PC meets the requirements but you still encounter technical issues (like crashing, freezing, or poor performance) during the test, please report it to us! The best place to do this is in the #bug-reports channel on our Discord. Providing details will help us fix the issue as quickly as possible.[/p][p][b]Q3: Will my progress from the CBT carry over to the full release?[/b][/p][p]No, all player data and progress will be completely wiped at the end of the test.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Important Notes[/b][/h3][p][b]Bug Feedback[/b]: Please remember that this is an early development build for the CBT. As such, you may encounter bugs, performance issues, or other instabilities. If you run into any problems during your gameplay, we strongly encourage you to report them! The best place for this is our official Discord server in the #bug-reports channel. Providing detailed information helps us fix issues much faster.[/p][p][b]A Note on Matchmaking[/b] Because this is a limited-capacity test, you may experience longer than usual queue times, especially during off-peak hours. We greatly appreciate your patience and understanding as we test our systems.[/p][hr][/hr][p]That covers the main information and frequently asked questions for the [i]Fate Trigger[/i] PC Closed Beta Test. We encourage all Awakeners to follow our official social media channels to stay up-to-date with the latest news and announcements.[/p][p]Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to see you in the game![/p]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Begins on Sep 25th!
notes.notes:
Feeling confused about how to join Fate Trigger: The Novita Closed Alpha? Check the frequently asked questions and answers below!

[b]1. What should I know about the Closed Alpha?[/b]
The Closed Alpha will be held on Steam from September 25th, 2024, at 7:00 AM (EDT) to September 30th, 2024 at 11:59 AM (EDT). After the test is over, the server will be closed, and all account information will be erased. 

[b]2. How do I get access to the Closed Alpha?[/b]
Visit [url=https://bit.ly/fttnsteam]https://bit.ly/fttnsteam[/url], and click "[b]Request Access[/b]" under "Join Fate Trigger: The Novita Playtest" to sign up.
We will grant a limited number of playtest access slots daily at 12 PM EDT. (Be sure to check both the Steam store page and your email for updates on your access status!)

[b]3. What's the Recommended System Requirement?[/b]
[b]Recommended Specs:[/b]
64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K/AMD Ryzen 9 5900X
Memory: 16GB*2 RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 Ti 8GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 30 GB available space (Recommend installation on SSD for optimal performance)

[b]Minimum Specs:[/b]
64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K/AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti 6GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 30 GB available space (Recommend installation on SSD for optimal performance)
*Please note that:
1. Unfortunately, AMD graphics cards are not supported in this test as we haven’t finished the compatibility development for the AMD series.
2. Likewise, laptops currently need higher specs to run the game, so we suggest playing on a PC whenever possible.

[b]4. What if I have more questions or need help?[/b]
Join our Discord community to get the latest updates and connect with us directly for answers. [url=https://discord.gg/fatetrigger]https://discord.gg/fatetrigger[/url]
